p37_manifest.dataset: NG14 P37 native FE case results

shift_mapping.configuration_ids: Published IDs use the UI shift-list number; source_configuration preserves the original FE ID.

p37_manifest.reason_sanitization: The HOLD traceback was replaced with a concise explanation; local absolute paths were excluded.
p37_manifest.archive_scope: This web dataset is the full case-metrics table, not the 33.8 GB raw research archive.
p37_manifest.encoding: UTF-8 CSV; gzip-compressed and base64-encoded in ordered text parts for GitHub contents transport

source_run_contract.direction_basis: G_X_NEG governed winding shell stress in all 7 non-single-span reviewed P36 models. X lateral governed 6/7 of those. Fixed representative direction; not an envelope of all wind directions.
source_run_contract.iteration_order: Reference P37 reuse + A/B, then first partial-contact configuration, then original full-orbit-first order; each configuration completes baseline, REPEAT and AB_SHIFT before next.
source_run_contract.target_rule: Top 3 panels by maximum native shell principal stress across G/L_X_NEG/G_X_NEG. In each panel repeat two distinct case-governing native spans, or two passes on the same span if only one governs.
source_run_contract.contact_contract: Same final completed P36 policy: ORIGINAL_CONTACT_V1 for full contact; AB_LOCAL_SLEEVE_CONTACT_V2 for required missing local sleeve contacts on partial orbits. Actual added self-weight included; no new supports or crossing bonds.
source_run_contract.legacy_result_reuse: Only exact same configuration and selected native case subset, after generated input physical equivalence checks; candidate targets must match before any reuse.
source_run_contract.output_policy: All 3 cases, global/panel extrema, hotspot IDs, reactions, frozen GH, hashes, native per-element contours and displacements. Same model assumptions as final P36. No capacity PASS.
source_run_contract.publication: Local collection only; no new public upload or deployment requested.
